analysis.summary: GNA Axles Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, noting a four percent decrease in net revenue alongside an improvement in net profit after tax. Management highlighted that domestic demand remained robust, particularly in the tractor and commercial vehicle segments, while export sales were impacted by tariffs imposed by the United States. The company advanced its strategic focus on expanding into light vehicles, passenger vehicles, and SUVs, while continuing investments in automation, renewable energy, and operational efficiency. Management reported a 2% increase in net revenue to 1,540 Cr, supported by export growth and strong customer relationships despite market uncertainty. The company incorporated GNA Mobility Limited in February 2025 to expand into advanced motor vehicle components.

guidance.claim: Domestic tractor sales are expected to post a lower single-digit growth in the current year.
guidance.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for commercial vehicles is expected to improve from FY 2024-25, driven by GDP growth, government incentives, and infrastructure focus.
demand_outlook.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains cautiously optimistic about domestic demand while monitoring geopolitical developments, interest rates, fuel prices, and inflation.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain cautiously optimistic about domestic demand while keeping a close watch on geopolitical developments, interest rates, fuel prices and inflation.

capex_expansion.claim: GNA Mobility Limited was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary in 2025 to expand presence in automotive components.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2025, we incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand our presence in automotive components.

capex_expansion.claim: A 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution.
capex_expansion.quote: Continuing this trajectory, a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution, reinforcing our dedication to expanding clean energy infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its solar capacity further in 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA of 210.61 Cr and an EBITDA margin of 13.68%.

orders_capacity.claim: Rooftop solar capacity was enhanced to 6 MW.
orders_capacity.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 3,882,041 rear axle shafts, 1,105,733 spindles, and 327,019 other shafts during 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 3 rupees per equity share for the financial year 2025-26.
The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 30% or ₹3.00 per equity share for 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its solar capacity further in the year 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
